name: Island of Saint-Louis
description: Saint-Louis sits on a narrow island in the mouth of the Senegal River, in northwest Senegal. French settlers founded it in the 17th century, and it served as the country's capital from 1872 to 1957. Wander its tidy grid of streets, past colonial-era buildings and along the riverside quays, to see why it became one of West Africa's most influential towns.
